questions.question: Which portfolio is stronger for a beginner?
options: 3 finished, deployed projects with clear READMEs
questions.explanation: Quality beats quantity. Live links and good READMEs show you can finish things.

questions.question: What makes a project README portfolio-ready?
options: What it does, a screenshot, how to run it, and what you learned
The full source code pasted in
questions.explanation: Recruiters skim. Make it easy to see what you built and why it matters.
